CustomField.description: Formula field decides if the Account segment is Midmarket, Emerging Growth or Core sales based on the number of employees
CustomField.formula: IF(NSP_Number_of_Employees__c > VALUE($Label.NSP_MidMarket_Threshold) , "MidMarket", IF(NSP_Number_of_Employees__c > VALUE($Label.NSP_Emerging_Growth_Threshold_Employees) && NSP_Number_of_Employees__c <= VALUE($Label.NSP_MidMarket_Threshold), "Emerging Growth", "Core Sales"))
CustomField.label: Account Segment
